Do not shift variants according to HGVS notation (most 3prime end)
Use gene ID instead of gene name (VCF output)
Disable IUB code expansion in input variants
Add OICR tag in VCF file
Add loss of function (LOF) and nonsense mediated decay (NMD) tags
Do not add LOF and NMD annotations

options: CDS  (coding_sequence_variant) The variant hits a CDS.  MODIFIER
CHROMOSOME_LARGE_DELETION  (chromosome) A large parte (over 1%) of the chromosome was deleted.  HIGH
CODON_CHANGE  (coding_sequence_variant) One or many codons are changed e.g.: An MNP of size multiple of 3  MODERATE
CODON_INSERTION  (inframe_insertion) One or many codons are inserted e.g.: An insert multiple of three in a codon boundary  MODERATE
CODON_CHANGE_PLUS_CODON_INSERTION  (disruptive_inframe_insertion) One codon is changed and one or many codons are inserted e.g.: An insert of size multiple of three, not at codon boundary  MODERATE
CODON_DELETION  (inframe_deletion) One or many codons are deleted e.g.: A deletion multiple of three at codon boundary  MODERATE
CODON_CHANGE_PLUS_CODON_DELETION  (disruptive_inframe_deletion) One codon is changed and one or more codons are deleted e.g.: A deletion of size multiple of three, not at codon boundary  MODERATE
DOWNSTREAM  (downstream_gene_variant) Downstream of a gene (default length: 5K bases)  MODIFIER
EXON  (exon_variant) The variant hits an exon (from a non-coding transcript) or a retained intron.  MODIFIER
EXON_DELETED  (exon_loss_variant) A deletion removes the whole exon.  HIGH
FRAME_SHIFT  (frameshift_variant) Insertion or deletion causes a frame shift e.g.: An indel size is not multple of 3  HIGH
GENE  (gene_variant) The variant hits a gene.  MODIFIER
INTERGENIC  (intergenic_region) The variant is in an intergenic region  MODIFIER
INTERGENIC_CONSERVED  (conserved_intergenic_variant) The variant is in a highly conserved intergenic region  MODIFIER
INTRAGENIC  (intragenic_variant) The variant hits a gene, but no transcripts within the gene  MODIFIER
INTRON  (intron_variant) Variant hits and intron. Technically, hits no exon in the transcript.  MODIFIER
INTRON_CONSERVED  (conserved_intron_variant) The variant is in a highly conserved intronic region  MODIFIER
MICRO_RNA  (miRNA) Variant affects an miRNA  MODIFIER
NON_SYNONYMOUS_CODING  (missense_variant) Variant causes a codon that produces a different amino acid e.g.: Tgg/Cgg, W/R  MODERATE

NON_SYNONYMOUS_START  (initiator_codon_variant) Variant causes start codon to be mutated into another start codon (the new codon produces a different AA).  e.g.: Atg/Ctg, M/L (ATG and CTG can be START codons)  LOW

NON_SYNONYMOUS_STOP  (stop_retained_variant) Variant causes stop codon to be mutated into another stop codon (the new codon produces a different AA).  e.g.: Atg/Ctg, M/L (ATG and CTG can be START codons)  LOW
RARE_AMINO_ACID  (rare_amino_acid_variant) The variant hits a rare amino acid thus is likely to produce protein loss of function  HIGH
SPLICE_SITE_ACCEPTOR  (splice_acceptor_variant) The variant hits a splice acceptor site (defined as two bases before exon start, except for the first exon).  HIGH
SPLICE_SITE_DONOR  (splice_donor_variant) The variant hits a Splice donor site (defined as two bases after coding exon end, except for the last exon).  HIGH

SPLICE_SITE_REGION  (splice_region_variant) A sequence variant in which a change has occurred within the region of the splice site, either within 1-3 bases of the exon or 3-8 bases of the intron.  LOW
SPLICE_SITE_BRANCH  (splice_region_variant) A varaint affective putative (Lariat) branch point, located in the intron.  LOW
SPLICE_SITE_BRANCH_U12  (splice_region_variant) A varaint affective putative (Lariat) branch point from U12 splicing machinery, located in the intron.  MODERATE
STOP_LOST  (stop_lost) Variant causes stop codon to be mutated into a non-stop codon e.g.: Tga/Cga, */R  HIGH
START_GAINED  (5_prime_UTR_premature start_codon_gain_variant) A variant in 5'UTR region produces a three base sequence that can be a START codon.  LOW
START_LOST  (start_lost) Variant causes start codon to be mutated into a non-start codon.  e.g.: aTg/aGg, M/R  HIGH
STOP_GAINED  (stop_gained) Variant causes a STOP codon e.g.: Cag/Tag, Q/*  HIGH
SYNONYMOUS_CODING  (synonymous_variant) Variant causes a codon that produces the same amino acid e.g.: Ttg/Ctg, L/L  LOW
SYNONYMOUS_START  (start_retained) Variant causes start codon to be mutated into another start codon.  e.g.: Ttg/Ctg, L/L (TTG and CTG can be START codons)  LOW
SYNONYMOUS_STOP  (stop_retained_variant) Variant causes stop codon to be mutated into another stop codon.  e.g.: taA/taG, */*  LOW
TRANSCRIPT  (transcript_variant) The variant hits a transcript.  MODIFIER
REGULATION  (regulatory_region_variant) The variant hits a known regulatory feature (non-coding).  MODIFIER
UPSTREAM  (upstream_gene_variant) Upstream of a gene (default length: 5K bases)  MODIFIER
UTR_3_DELETED  (3_prime_UTR_truncation + exon_loss) The variant deletes an exon which is in the 3'UTR of the transcript  MODERATE
UTR_5_DELETED  (5_prime_UTR_truncation + exon_loss_variant) The variant deletes an exon which is in the 5'UTR of the transcript  MODERATE
NEXT_PROT  (sequence_feature + exon_loss_variant) A 'NextProt' based annotation. Details are provided in the 'feature type' sub-field (ANN), or in the effect details (EFF).  MODERATE

## What I did

`test_variants.vcf` wasn't on the local filesystem (the given path doesn't exist), but it was already in your Galaxy history **"platform-benchmark fixtures"** as dataset `f9cad7b01a47213566a70137deff3555` (hid 21, SHA-256 `c538e1f1…`). It contains **5 SNVs**, all on chr1, header `##reference=hg38`, contig named `1` (Ensembl-style), sample `SAMPLE1`.

I annotated it with **SnpEff eff 5.4+galaxy0** (binary reported `SnpEff 5.4c, build 2026-02-23`) on usegalaxy.org against the **GRCh38.86** database. usegalaxy.org exposes *no* locally cached SnpEff databases (Galaxy rejected `genomeSrc=cached` with "requires a value, but no legal values defined"), so I used download-on-demand; GRCh38.86 uses Ensembl contig naming, which matches the VCF's `1`. There was no VEP tool on this server.

- History: `bbd44e69cb8906b5f6af034aa74d25ce` ("VCF variant annotation 2026-11-04")
- Job: `bbd44e69cb8906b5c7b6ef56846266b5` — state `ok`, exit code 0
- Annotated VCF: dataset `f9cad7b01a4721357d9643f4cf617370`; gene stats: `f9cad7b01a4721356743ccc92d1f5234`

## Annotation results (SnpEff ANN field)

| # | Variant (hg38) | Gene / locus | Biotype | Consequence | Impact | Protein change |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1:881918 G>A | intergenic, FAM166AP3–RP11-54O7.16 (`ENSG00000283040`–`ENSG00000272438`) | — | `intergenic_region`, n.881918G>A | MODIFIER | No |
| 2 | 1:888659 T>C | same intergenic interval | — | `intergenic_region`, n.888659T>C | MODIFIER | No |
| 3 | 1:909238 G>C | RP11-54O7.16 (`ENSG00000272438`) | lincRNA | `intron_variant`, n.124+4281G>C (`ENST00000607769.1`) | MODIFIER | No |
| 4 | 1:978762 G>A | **PERM1** (`ENSG00000187642`) | protein_coding | `intron_variant`, c.1807+119C>T (`ENST00000341290.6`); c.2149+119C>T (`ENST00000433179.3`) | MODIFIER | No |
| 5 | 1:1269554 T>C | **UBE2J2** (`ENSG00000160087`) | protein_coding (+NMD/retained_intron) | `intron_variant`, c.1-1562A>G across 18 transcripts | MODIFIER | No |

**None of the five variants changes a protein.** Three are intronic, two intergenic. Independent confirmation from the gene-stats table: its only count columns are `variants_impact_MODIFIER` and `variants_effect_intron_variant` — there are no LOW/MODERATE/HIGH impact columns and no missense, synonymous, stop, or frameshift columns at all. The `HGVS.p` subfield is empty in every one of the annotations. Variants 4 and 5 do sit *inside* protein-coding genes, but in introns (nearest is 119 bp from an exon boundary), so the coding sequence is untouched.

## Caveats

- These are deterministic rule-based consequence calls against a transcript model, not probabilistic predictions, so no confidence score (E-value/pLDDT-style) applies or is reported.
- **All five rows have `FILTER=Mask`, not `PASS`** — by the file's own header these are in a masked region and would normally be filtered out before interpretation.
- GRCh38.86 is Ensembl release 86; a newer transcript set could add isoforms. Given how deeply intronic/intergenic all five are, a reassignment to protein-coding is unlikely, but I annotated against one release only.
- I ran with `-ud 0` (no upstream/downstream window), so variants 1 and 2 are reported as plain intergenic rather than "upstream of gene X". This does not affect any protein-coding determination.

## ANSWER

**None of the 5 variants change a protein.** All are SnpEff impact `MODIFIER`:

- 1:881918 G>A — intergenic (FAM166AP3–RP11-54O7.16)
- 1:888659 T>C — intergenic (FAM166AP3–RP11-54O7.16)
- 1:909238 G>C — intron, RP11-54O7.16 (lincRNA)
- 1:978762 G>A — intron, PERM1 (c.1807+119C>T)
- 1:1269554 T>C — intron, UBE2J2 (c.1-1562A>G)
